svg.title: MGRiT (heat equation)
svg.desc:
Numerical experiment with panels: MGRiT (heat equation); MGRiT (ADE with $
u=0.1$); MGRiT (ADE with $
u=0.01$); Parareal (heat equation); Parareal (ADE with $
u=0.1$); Parareal (ADE with $
u=0.01$)
